purpose: Three sealed pair checks first; then two descriptive scientific static PNGs and matching exact-value CSVs. No solver, native decoder, subprocess or new scientific acceptance gate.
optional_fresh_tag: --tag upl_gpu_column_plot_rN (positive integer N; default r1); every output must not already exist, including partial failures

reused_dependency.functions: entry/adopt/bind/readjson/require/dataset only; imported module main is not called
reused_dependency.hash_cost: One shared TRACKED cache verifies unique existing pair inputs and datasets once, plus one final unchanged-file rehash; no duplicate raw/source hash traversal per curve.

required_prior: All three passed=true, physical_acceptance=false, all declared gates true, 769 parts x 1000 soil IDs x 26 columns and sealed metrics/files/inputs. Original 5 Pa and 0.005 mm gates are unchanged; this plot script does not replace numerical QC.

datasets.CPU_coarse: logs/upl_case02_flux_window25_coarse_r1.native.check.json; retained OMP1, historical source snapshots only
datasets.note: Loaded only after all pair checks pass. CPU half contributes the already sealed cross-half difference CSV, not a fourth backend state curve.

schema.name: case02_private26_col21_ExcessPorePress_NOT_wave26
schema.physical: 12-byte (1000,26,769) header then actual time double and 1000x26 double values per frame
schema.clock: 8-byte (769,28) header; actual double time, uint32 zero-based saved step, double locked dt, double signed dterror
schema.columns: Exact frozen pair.F list; column21 is native ExcessPorePress, NOT PosDiv. Native pressure is float promoted to double; J/theta/stored stress are native saved values. No native V/rho/k is fabricated.

spatial_reduction.layers: Initial material z0, round(z0/0.01-0.5), exactly 100 layers x 10 soil IDs. All 1000 soil IDs included; fixed particles excluded.
spatial_reduction.top_bottom: Initial layer99/top10 and layer0/bottom10, not dynamic sorting or fixed-wall samples
spatial_reduction.settlement: Downward positive = -(z-z0)*1000 mm, not velocity integral
spatial_reduction.pressure_RMS: sqrt(mean(p^2)) over all 1000 native soil IDs; not error against theory
spatial_reduction.stress: -mean(stored sigma_zz) for compression-positive display, not a claimed total/effective-stress decomposition
spatial_reduction.theta: Saved last-force theta RMS or layer mean; not a reconstructed instantaneous time derivative

panels: three sealed pair pressure RMS differences + 5 Pa line
three sealed pair maximum XYZ material-displacement differences + 0.005 mm line
figure_history.time: Every backend/pair retains its own actual times, displayed in ms over full 0..25 ms. No resampling or interpolation.
figure_history.insets: Difference panels repeat every point with automatic data-scale axes while the main axes keep the unchanged original limit lines; no filtering/clipping or fitted limits.

figure_profiles.selection: Each backend independently takes argmin(abs(actual_time-requested_time)); exact actual time/part/completed step in CSV and rounded actual ms labels in figure. No temporal interpolation.
figure_profiles.panels: 5 requested instants x pressure / downward material settlement / stored compression -sigma_zz, plotted against initial material height. Each point averages 10 real soil IDs across x.
figure_profiles.additional_CSV_fields: current mean z, J and saved theta layer means, all in stated SI units except settlement mm

check: logs/upl_gpu_column_plot_r1.check.json; binds both current plot author files, frozen pair files/checks, unique sealed input entries, output hashes and actual selected times. passed means evidence-bound descriptive artifacts written, not new physical/scientific acceptance.
failure: Fresh outputs only. A failure writes passed=false with retained partial files and error; do not silently overwrite or rerun at the same tag.
restrictions: private master OFF / constant k=float(0.0001) / g=0 / one FreeSlip bottom / X periodic
no HG, SPR, viscosity or damping; not unchanged formal NoSlip physics
do not compare CPU fixed-n zero markers with GPU fixed-n mirror samples
no theory truth, fitted reference, smoothing, missing-frame interpolation, field masking, physical-release or long-term validation claim
10 ms event equality is the pre-open saved state; plotting does not prove force-stage load balance or flux conservation
root must execute only after complete inputs are sealed, then inspect both rendered PNGs; author/static parse is not render or visual QA
